data_fields.name: shuffle_bag_refill
data_fields.donor_constant: refill from the full clip list when empty; no repeat until empty

data_fields.name: max_voices
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no global cap read in Sound.cs)

best_idea: give each source (attacker, unit) its own voice slot with an explicit do-not-play, interrupt or overlap policy, and pick clips from a shuffle bag, so many-on-one fights do not stack the same sound
decision_why: Take the per-source slot with policy and the shuffle bag; add the global cap and the prune the donor lacks; do not copy the shared slot for enemies or the looping stinger.
acceptance: with three attackers hitting the player, each attacker has its own cue slot; a second hit from the same attacker while its cue is still playing is skipped (do-not-play), and the total of cues sounding at once never exceeds the cap; a defeat stinger plays once and then the zone background resumes.
